description: This file defines configuration options for Keycloak authentication and an extension method to add JWT authentication to an ASP.NET Core application's service collection.

classes.name: KeycloakOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Keycloak integration such as ClientId, ClientSecret, KeycloakUrl, and Realm.

methods.name: AddJwtAuthentication
methods.description: An extension method that configures JWT Bearer authentication using Keycloak settings from the app configuration.
